This outperformance is further supported by the recent trend where profit growth exceeds price growth by 3%, indicating that the company may be starting to outperform expectations [E50]. While DAMCAPITAL has experienced a negative sales growth of -5% in the trailing twelve months, this could be mitigated by its strong earnings growth of 103% over three years [E16]. The screen reason for bullishness from scanX signal engine also indicates that both sales and earnings growth are accelerating [E56] and [E57], suggesting a positive outlook. In conclusion, DAMCAPITAL's underappreciated value is evident through its lower P/E ratio compared to the sector benchmark, strong profitability metrics, and recent outperformance in key financial indicators. These factors collectively support the notion that DAMCAPITAL may be undervalued by the market.
